name: VATHEN Knowledge Operating System Agent Index
source_scope: 59 related Notion pages discovered within the 先知资料库 hierarchy and linked VATHEN/DAC materials, plus 51 rows from the two linked development task databases.
sync_note: Curated static snapshot: 59 related Notion pages and 51 rows from two linked task databases. Knowledge is reorganized into strategic direction, product capabilities, operations/delivery, and archive layers. Not live-synchronized with Notion.
reading_protocol: Load data/knowledge-architecture.json first; it is the canonical taxonomy and navigation map.
Read the relevant module's knowledge_summary, knowledge_model, boundary, upstream and downstream fields before opening source pages.
Follow the role-based reading_paths in the architecture for strategic, product, research, or engineering work.
Treat role=core as authoritative reference candidates, not automatically approved decisions; always inspect status.
Treat role=task as execution records and use Notion as the current status source; this website is a static snapshot.
Treat role=related as supporting evidence and role=archive as historical traceability only.
Preserve Notion source URLs and IDs. Do not infer approval, deployment, or real-time operation from inclusion in this index.

database_sources.name: VATHEN DAC 开发任务看板

organization_principles: 按业务逻辑而不是原始页面来源组织知识；战略、能力、运营和档案分层。
每个重要主题只设置一个正式入口，相关文档作为支撑材料，避免多处重复维护。
将长期有效的标准知识、正在推进的项目任务、研究素材和历史档案分开呈现。
明确区分已确认基线、建议方案、待验证假设、实施状态和历史记录。
每个模块都说明使命、核心结论、运行模型、上下游依赖、权威资料和适用边界。
Notion 保持源数据与任务状态事实来源；网站是静态快照，除非部署同步服务，不宣称实时更新。

retrieval_rules.strategy: Mission, target audience, value proposition, competitive positioning, business model and market assumptions.
retrieval_rules.brand: Brand narrative, voice, visual identity, design standards and experience consistency.
retrieval_rules.product: Product portfolio, user journeys, PRDs, information architecture, MVP scope and permission boundaries.
retrieval_rules.research: Research questions, evidence standards, source verification, editorial voice, writing workflow and quality gates.
retrieval_rules.data: DAC, source adapters, data licensing, canonical models, evidence, entities, events, relationships and intelligence dashboards.
retrieval_rules.technology: System architecture, ADRs, engineering standards, Agent Runtime, tool permissions, evaluation, monitoring and automation.
retrieval_rules.governance: Knowledge lifecycle, source of truth, versioning, decision records, audits, roadmap and operational cadence.
retrieval_rules.execution: Project tasks, Backlog, Sprint delivery, Agent handoff, QA, acceptance evidence and task closure.
retrieval_rules.archive: Original Notion pages, historical snapshots, old dashboards and traceability-only records.
